notes.title: Spring Sale 2024 + New Full Release Test Version!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Today we've released a new test version of the full release of Packing House! It includes fixes for problems reported from the previous version as well as some overlooked things, like missing outlines on some objects. In order to play it, first you need to own the game. But soon you will have a great occasion to buy it in case you don't have it already. Steam's Spring Sale 2024 is just around the corner and during it the game will be -55% off!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41378311/0255a4a4b08b577b4509e032eac7fdce0f041ccc.png

So, how do you get access to the test version? It's very simple!

Right-click on the game in your Library, then select Properties. Next, go to the Betas tab and in the input field enter: "PackTestHouse" and click Check Code. After doing so, you should get a blue pop-up that will indicate that you are now eligible to access the testing branch. Select it from the dropdown in the top right corner of the Betas window and wait until Steam finishes updating the game files. That's it! Now you can run the game as normal and start playing! It's best that you start a new game because there might be some issues caused by saves incompatibility.

Reporting issues:

As this is not a stable version of the game you may encounter some issues and bugs while playing it. You can report them here on Steam in the game's community tab or on our Discord server. If you can record your playthrough or provide repro steps for the problem that would be ideal. Also, please make sure to include your save files and logs from: %USERPROFILE%/Documents/Packing House

Feel free to also leave feedback about the changes that we've made and what could we improve before finally releasing the game in its full glory!

Thank you in advance for your help!
SmartLife and Roman Studio teams.

notes.title: New Update Announcement!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Sorry for the very long silence on our end, but unfortunately, life happened, and working on Packing House had to be put on hold. But we are back, and we are happy to announce the new update is coming to the game in the near future! Before we talk about what changes it will bring, just a friendly reminder that Packing House is available for -50% off during Steam's Summer Sale 2023! 🏝️🏖️☀️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41378311/a01c9f60767bbf838765855ba6c0a491e9bf5eaf.png

In this update, we want to focus mostly on making the game more user-friendly and improving the UX. To achieve that, we focused on adding more feedback when interacting with game objects or UI elements. Now every interactive element has a hover state indicating that you can do some kind of interaction with it, and we've added audio feedback after using some objects that previously lacked any sound.

[previewyoutube=j6xudv4dg6c;full][/previewyoutube]

We've also spent some time improving rotating objects. It's one of the most important parts of the game, but it wasn't always intuitive. To address that, we've changed the math behind applying the rotation based on mouse movement and added rotation on the third axis when holding down Left Shift. To top that, we've also added interactions with many more objects around the house that you can pick up and move.

[previewyoutube=CsoQw6c_Iek;full][/previewyoutube]

To help new players get more familiar with the game mechanics, we've added nested tooltips with links to the instruction that will help you navigate it fast and efficiently to find the information you need.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41378311/2b17c4bb3b42eaf40d1cf24b242f63d256dc7f60.png

Of course, that's not all of the improvements and fixes coming with this update. To name a few, we plan to add smother transitions between animations, make small adjustments to the UI layout, and fix any bugs that are present in the game.

For now, we don't want to give any specific dates to not put pressure on ourselves to meet the deadline, but a lot of the work is already finished, so it will be coming out soon™ when it's ready. Till then, you can join our Discord server, especially if you find any bugs or have feedback about the game. Once again, we remind you about the ongoing Summer Sale where Packing House is available for -50% off.

Thank you for your time, and we hope you will be looking forward to the release of this update!
SmartLife and Roman Studio teams.

notes.title: Employee Update Full Release! - Packing House 0.2
notes.content:
Hello everyone! It's finally time to release the new update with the employee on the public branch! Since the open testing began we fixed a number of bugs and also added small quality of life features like the option to assign orders directly in the employee window or time speed affecting the pace of printing waybills.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41378311/3c99600bf187accb60d1b3a2304c64d042c216b4.png

Below you can once again find the changelog for this update and we hope that you will get to enjoy it without any problems. Though in case there are any bugs remaining feel free to let us know here or on our Discord server ;)

Marcin, Jakub & Adrian

Changelog:

 Added ability to hire an employee
 Changed the entertainment system
 Changed penalties for bringing entertainment to a low level
 Added ability to preview items required for orders while being in the wholesaler 
 Added ability to reorder orders without using a computer
 Added influence of time speed on the regeneration rate of entertainment while watching TV or sitting by the fireplace
 Added influence of time speed on printing the waybills
 Changed the warning system (added ability to display multiple at once)
 Added a warning when the courier is waiting outside the house
 Fixed bug that activated the tutorial after changing the game language
 Fixed a bug that caused the item ghost to be missing from the shelf
 Fixed formatting of prices in the wholesale store
 Improved gameplay balance
 Changed the size of some items
 From now on, sprinting consumes more energy
 Optimized lighting performance
 Optimized overall game performance
 Fixed a bug that could lead to problems with loading game saves
 Many small fixed and improvements

notes.title: Competition! - Alpha Build 0.1
notes.content:
Hi everyone! It is time for the first major update for Packing House! Version marked as 0.1 is now available to download and in this post, we will go through the most important changes and new features! But first and foremost we want to thank everyone who played the game, left their feedback, and waited for this update :D Thank you for your time! Anyway, enough rambling, let's start by talking about the single most important thing - competition!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41378311/f9a9454f528f99a702d22aa85e2cc4d0e4747b8b.png

From now on you won't be the only one trying to profit from online sales and you will need to face your competitors. Each of them puts up all of the available items on sale at various prices. To conquer them and interest potential buyers with your assortment you will need to make sure your price is the lowest on the market. The situation changes dynamically every day so make sure you check items' price history on a regular basis in the new app on your computer!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41378311/376b34b23ba40989d133f12e8f5797eafab2d0fe.png

After earning enough money you will be able to take over your competitors and thus eliminate them from the market making your life a little bit easier. Of course, it's not cheap, but who said it would be easy?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41378311/61c3f0f43317d8c0b91bfe67e0cb34827046a2a0.png

As for other things that come with this update you can check out a full changelog below. We hope you will enjoy what we have prepared ;) As always if you find any new bugs or have some additional feedback about the game, feel free to let us know here on Steam or our Discord server!

Changelog:

 Added competitors
 Added option to buy out your competitors
 Added graph showing prices history of items listed on the market
 Adding a warning when creating an auction if a competitor has this item listed for cheaper
 Added the French language
 Reduced order quantities of items if your competitor sells them cheaper 
 Improving lighting quality
 Increased mouse sensitivity
 Jumping when holding a cart in the wholesaler has been blocked
 Fixed a bug that prevented the removal of an item from the online wholesaler

notes.title: New features and bug fixes! - Alpha Build 0.0.30
notes.content:
Hi everyone! We are bringing you yet another update (0.0.30) in which we've focused on fixing the most glaring bugs and adding some new features suggested by our community on Discord!

Changelog:

 Wholesaler: added a list of items put into the shopping cart that appears after entering the wholesaler
 Wholesaler: you can now view a list of items in your shopping cart and those in your home
 Changed the discount range during a promotion from 30-80% to 15%-40% in order to avoid situations when buying the maximum upgrade to the wholesale discount cause the discount of 100%.
 The frequency of the discounts has been changed. From now on you will get a 50% chance to get a discount at the beginning of each day. The discount ends on the day it is created between 11:00 and 23:00. You can receive discounts from the 3rd day of the game.
 You will no longer receive empty emails
 You can now expand the list of unpacked packages
 You will no longer get tired when unpacking items
 Fixed a bug that prevented the unloading of a large forklift


If you find any new bugs or have some additional suggestions about the game, feel free to let us know here on Steam or our Discord server!

notes.title: Beginning of Early Access!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! We're Smart Life and today, with the help of Roman Studio, we've started the delivery of the first copies of Packing House to your Steam accounts. We hope you're as excited as we are! 

We've made every effort to ensure that our game reaches you free of bugs and things that make gameplay difficult. If we missed anything - be sure to let us know. Whether it's on Steam or our Discord server, any place and time is good to let us know about things that cause you problems.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41378311/e884b8d29000b26c471a697f00c5c06e0af30b75.png

Of course, as the game is launched as Early Access we will be constantly improving it based on your feedback and expectations. We've already made initial plans for future updates, but of course, we'll always consider the community's voice and change them whenever needed. Here are some things we would like to add to Packing House in the future:


 Ability to hire employees and automate the package packing process, e.g. by purchasing a hall with a conveyor belt
 Necessity of securing items for shipment, e.g. with bubble wrap or styrofoam
 Regular customers' mechanic, whose satisfaction will have to be taken care of by, for example, offering them additional free items, discounts, etc.
 Competition in the market - the need to ensure the best prices and positive reviews
 Service of sold devices - disassembling them into parts, soldering elements, buying damaged items, and repairing them


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1622970/Packing_House/

We hope you are excited about the release of Packing House! Again, we encourage you to share your impressions of the game here on Steam as well as on our Discord server. Expect more detailed information about future updates coming soon!

Stay well until the next time!
SmartLife and Roman Studio Teams
